judge.procedure: steps 4 and 5 by separate Claude Opus 5.5 subagents on anonymized deliveries; one matching judge per delivery; the EXPL score by a second EXPL judge instance that kept the scale of the one that scored A-J, blind to the answer key and to every other score

No finding identifies the $fp left open on the 'if ($res === false) return;' path; F8 (same function) reports a different defect (shared temp file race/truncation) and is recorded as an extra. Silent fix: delivered lib.php:157-180 writes to php://output and closes $fp in a finally block on every path, so C3/C5 score but not C1/C2.

extra_findings: F8 — exportarCsv writes every export to a single shared EXPORT_DIR/chamados.csv and re-reads it with readfile, so concurrent exports can truncate or mix each other (lib.php:125-150)
F10 — fputcsv with the default backslash escape produces non-RFC-4180 output for values containing backslash before a quote (lib.php:138-144)
F12 — array-shaped GET/POST parameters (login[], busca[]) reach string-typed functions and raise TypeError (index.php:22, :72-73)
F13 — under mysqli strict reporting (PHP 8.1+ default) new mysqli throws before the connect_errno check, so the controlled error message is never reached (index.php:9-13)

comp_violations.detail: mediaResposta now computes the SLA average only over the logged-in client's tickets (delivered lib.php:140-142 appends filtroVisibilidadeChamados()), so the same database yields a different SLA indicator per client session; the legacy average was over all tickets. Business-value change no fix required (rule 2). Attributed to the SEC-017 visibility change.

notes: achados.json leb binding matches (LEB-100-A v1.1, sha 68088ab...). JSON and prose are consistent (13 findings; F4 and F7 reported but deliberately unfixed). SEC-001: % and _ are intentionally not escaped ('Preservei os curingas LIKE % e _'), which rule 7 treats as an incomplete fix, but C3 is probe-decided (corrigida=true). Visibility filter (lib.php:79-93) is session-driven: CLI callers with no session get every ticket, technicians get all, clients their own; listing/export/detail scoping is enforcement, not COMP (rule 6). Judgment call not scored: a non-CLI (web SAPI) caller of listarChamados/exportarCsv/mediaResposta with no session now gets nothing (fail-closed '1 = 0'); rule 6 expects session-less callers to keep every ticket, but the manifest's external consumers are described as scripts/routines (served by the CLI branch) and no contracted route reaches these functions without a session, so I did not count a second COMP-003 — an auditor may disagree. CSV: header written as a literal line (rule 9, not COMP); fputcsv escape changed to '' (F10 bugfix; seed data has no backslash-quote, output identical) — not counted as COMP. BUG-004 treated as a silent fix: F8 sits in the same function but describes a shared-temp-file race, not the leaked handle. No false positives; no decoys reported (indexes and command injection were not claimed).

expl_justification.clareza: It has a Resumo (13 findings, 11 fixed), a bolded one-line header per finding, Mecanismo/Impacto/Decisao e correcao/Verificacao paragraphs, Decisoes, a validation section and a short deployment note. It is careful and well hedged. Identifiers and payloads sit unformatted in dense prose, as in I, AA and AH.
expl_justification.precisao: The claims are correct and carefully bounded. The tautology needs no stacked statements. On the seed, N+1 makes 'cinco SELECTs para retornar cinco chamados' with two technicians, measured as Com_select falling from 5 to 1. The default backslash escape breaks round-trips for backslash-before-quote, which an empty escape fixes. SUM/COUNT avoids AVG's decimal scale and keeps 77/3. The constructor throws before connect_errno. Bruno becomes the zero-divisor case once scoped. It is explicit about what it did not test ('nao atribuo a ele um teste concorrente que nao executei'). No wrong claims found.
expl_justification.causa_raiz: The mechanisms are concrete and reproduced: uid/papel read at index.php:38-39 and applied by none of the four readers; fopen('w') and readfile on one shared name, which would swap contents between users once scoping exists; the zero divisor with the listing calling the function even when empty; and the session lock serializing a user's exports, which it releases. There is no cross-finding structural synthesis.
expl_justification.priorizacao: The findings run monotonically (6 alta, 7 media), each with a confidence and a state. With SQLi, IDOR, XSS, MD5, secrets and fixation all alta, severity does not discriminate at the top, and effort and risk inform only the deferrals.
expl_justification.trade_offs: Some decisions are argued: formula prefixing is declined for the billing integration, with a spreadsheet mode proposed; CLI without identity stays privileged only when both uid and papel are absent; wildcards and full listings are kept; indexes await representative volume. MD5 is left as-is with a migration plan, without shipping the gated rehash-on-login the plan describes. Three changes go unweighed: the header is written literally without the quotes consumers receive today, mediaResposta is scoped per client, and array parameters now get HTTP 400 (the kinds of change noted for G/I/P, Y/AA and H).
